eng.title: SCSU International Admissions - English proficiency requirements (undergraduate)

test_policy.notes: 'SCSU is completely test optional.' Submit ACT/SAT only if they may enhance admission or scholarship consideration. Guaranteed admission with a 2.5 GPA (4.0 scale) for students with no college credits.

requirements.notes: SCSU's own online application; no application fee ('SCSU no longer requires an application fee'). No essay or recommendations are required (optional). International applicants must show a bank statement of at least US$29,178 for the first year (dated within 6 months) and a Financial Form.

deadlines.label: International priority deadline, fall 2027 (applicants outside the U.S.)
deadlines.notes: Applicants inside the U.S.: July 15. Later applications are still considered but may be deferred to the next term. The page prints dates without a year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The Common Data Set 2024-25 lists Aug. 15 as the general closing date with rolling admission.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Alternatives to a test: graduation from a U.S. high school; English-medium high school or university graduation with a 2.5 GPA plus a principal's letter; IGCSE/O-Levels with C or above in English, math, a hard science, a social science and one other subject; 12+ U.S. university credits with 2.5 GPA; completion of SCSU's Intensive English Center; ELS level 112; SAT ERW 400+ (or Reading 20+); ACT English 15+; LanguageCERT 60. Reports must be under 2 years old. Conditional admission is available for qualified applicants whose English is below the requirement.

english.notes: Tests on/after 2026-01-21 (page does not name the 1-6 scale).
IELTS Indicator at 5.5 is accepted 'until further notice'.

Official report must come through the Duolingo dashboard. A separate graduate-admissions knowledge-base article says Duolingo will not be accepted from Summer 2026; the undergraduate page still lists it, so confirm with International Admissions.
PTE Academic, score report website only.

aid.notes: Academic and Cultural Sharing Scholarship (ACSS) lowers international undergraduate tuition (about $8,652 per year on the costs page; renewable each semester with a 2.5 GPA and cultural-sharing activities). The costs page says students opt in at orientation; other SCSU pages describe it as applied automatically to the first semester. Need-based awards depend on FAFSA, which international students cannot file.
